Create a wallet or add an address to watch.

Network data uses Massa Labs, its explorer, CoinGecko and Frankfurter. Providers see IP and request metadata; Massa services see requested public addresses or operation IDs. Optional scheduled balance checks use Massa Labs. Transfers require review and fresh device authorization.

Checks confirmed balances about every 15 minutes or later, even with the app closed. Android, battery saving and network availability can delay checks. Public addresses are sent to Massa Labs. No instant push service.
Native self-custodial Massa wallet for Android. Private keys stay protected on this device.
Independent community wallet. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Massa Labs.

Available: protected wallets, read-only balances, Receive, activity, currency estimates and no-broadcast Send review. Next: dedicated physical acceptance, UI polish and a separately authorized live-Send review. Planned: charts, address book and further ecosystem features. No dates guaranteed.

Keys remain on this device, excluded from Android backup. Device loss, app removal or security changes can make keys unavailable. Keep a separate offline backup. Revealed keys hide after 30 seconds or when leaving; external cameras cannot be prevented.
Transfers require your review and device-owner authentication.
Reveal only in private. The key hides after 30 seconds or when you leave. Android blocks capture while it is visible; external cameras cannot be blocked.
